items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Sign up for a free account — no credit card required. You'll get immediate access to all core features and 3 free actions per month.

items.question: What counts as an action?
items.answer: An action is one use of the core product feature. Free users get 3 per month; Pro users get unlimited.

items.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
items.answer: Yes. You can upgrade to Pro at any time from your account settings, and cancel whenever you want — no lock-in.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. All data is stored in a Supabase Postgres database with encrypted connections. We never sell your data.

whyWeBuilt.heading: Why we built this
whyWeBuilt.story:
I've spent years building SaaS products — and every single time, I wasted the first 2–3 weeks on the exact same things: auth setup, billing integration, database schema, and boilerplate UI.

The idea wasn't the hard part. The infrastructure was.

So I built this starter to solve that problem — for myself first, and then for every other founder who was tired of reinventing the wheel. One config file. Production-quality code. Ship in days, not weeks.
highlights: Built from real experience shipping 10+ SaaS products
Every decision made to maximise iteration speed
Open to feedback — this is built in public
